positive_controls.description: FIBIU-11: an outcome can be explicitly classified materiality_classification='material' with justification, distinct from and independent of the legacy 1-5 materialityScore; the classification persists and is readable back.

FIBIU-11 (scope-corrected during mission-loop cycle 1 — FIBIU-11's own FILES_OR_DOMAINS registry entry names only db/schema.ts, lib/pipeline/outcomes.ts, and app/app/projects/[projectId]/pipeline/outcomes/**, not lib/pipeline/sroi-calculation.ts; numerator-exclusion wiring is FIBIU-19's eligibility composition, Wave 3): a 'not_material' classification (with justification) persists and is returned unchanged by listOutcomesForProject/getOutcomeByIdForProject, exactly like a 'material' one -- the value is never dropped, nulled, or specially filtered by the read path itself, so it remains available for later eligibility composition to consume.

FIBIU-12: recording disposition='monetized' for an outcome on a run-version persists and is readable; recording disposition='not_monetized' requires and persists reason + justification, and the outcome retains materiality/evidence/traceability without contributing to the numerator.
FIBIU-12: the coverage view (monetized / material-not-monetized / not-yet-eligible / other, each with a distinct reason) is computable and visible before run approval.

FIBIU-13: getFilterJustificationIssues() reports no issue for a filter set where each of deadweight/attribution/displacement/drop_off/duration has an explicit value of 0 together with its own discrete justification column (0 does not exempt justification, and a justified 0 is not treated as missing).

negative_controls.description: FIBIU-11 (scope-corrected during mission-loop cycle 1 -- MATERIALITY_UNCLASSIFIED as an enforced eligibility-gate rejection is FIBIU-19's job, Wave 3, out of FIBIU-11's FILES_OR_DOMAINS): an outcome created or updated with only the legacy 1-5 materialityScore set never has materiality_classification silently populated by that write -- no code path in lib/pipeline/outcomes.ts derives/infers materiality_classification from materialityScore; the two fields are written by entirely separate, independently-invoked functions.

FIBIU-12: when no outcome on a run has a defensible/monetized disposition, no SROI ratio is emitted (the no-ratio path), while results reporting remains permitted; upstream silent-drop paths (loadCalculationData discarding an assignment lacking input/filter/proxy/outcome) are itemized as a distinct exclusion reason rather than silently vanishing.

FIBIU-13 (scope-corrected during mission-loop cycle 2 -- wiring this into an actual approval/lock BLOCK is FIBIU-19's eligibility composition, Wave 3, out of FIBIU-13's own FILES_OR_DOMAINS, mirroring the FIBIU-11 P-2/N-1 correction above): getFilterJustificationIssues() reports FILTER_JUSTIFICATION_MISSING naming the specific filter when a value is present with no justification, and FILTER_VALUE_MISSING when the value itself is NULL -- the null check runs before any numeric coercion, so a NULL value is never silently read as a justified 0 on this function's path.
FIBIU-13: discount_rate_pct is deliberately excluded from the five-filter justification gate and never blocks eligibility for missing justification.

Audit action verb/object correspondence (FIBC-040): every new logAuditAction call this batch introduces (outcome.materiality_classified or equivalent, outcome_monetization_disposition.recorded) has an entityType whose prefix matches the governed action object, verified by the existing static scan.

mutation_controls.description: Deleting the outcomes_materiality_pair-style guard that keeps materiality_classification and its justification atomic (both NULL or both set) is caught: a write with one set and the other NULL fails.

Deleting the 'reason NOT NULL when disposition=not_monetized' / 'justification NOT NULL with reason' guard on outcome_monetization_dispositions is caught: a not_monetized row missing reason or justification fails to persist.

Reintroducing a parseNum(null)-style coercion inside getFilterJustificationIssues (checking the value with parseNum instead of an explicit null/undefined/empty-string test) is caught: a NULL filter value would silently report no issue or FILTER_JUSTIFICATION_MISSING-only instead of FILTER_VALUE_MISSING.
